[SWS_PER_00410] applies.
All operations on a
Key-Value Storage
will be done in a temporary storage cre-
ated during the call to
ara::per::OpenKeyValueStorage
, which the
applica-
tion
can persist using
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::SyncToStorage
, or re-
set to the last stored state with
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::DiscardPend-
ingChanges
.
Therefore, if the
Key-Value Storage
is just destructed (also implicitly when the
Process
terminates), the
Key-Value Storage
is not updated, and the next time the
Key-Value Storage
is accessed, the
application
will see the last saved state.
